notes:
v4.6.6 — Text-only AI bot support (Llama, GPT-4o-mini, Haiku-text)

✨ NEW
• Make Bot AI prompt now explicitly blesses text-only AI providers. When you pick Llama via Groq, GPT-4o-mini, or any other text LLM, the generated bot builds features as NUMBERS (SMA, RSI, MACD, returns, volume ratios) and asks the LLM for a JSON decision via the OpenAI-style chat completions API. No more accidentally-generated vision-only bots that crash on a text-only provider.
• BOT_SKELETON.md gains a Text-Only AI section with a copy-pasteable Llama decide() template that requests `response_format=json_object` and falls back to HOLD on any AI call failure. Future Make Bot generations crib from this pattern automatically.
• Bot tab log output: pinned to left alignment so daybot's `===` banner header no longer makes shorter lines render visually centered.
• Server-side bot log rotation: each bot start now opens the log in write mode (rotates the previous run to *.bak), so users no longer see every historical traceback pile up forever after each restart.

🚀 IMPACT
• You can now generate a fully working Llama-driven crypto / stock bot with one Make Bot click using Groq's free tier — text-only, sub-second decisions, no vision API quota burn.
